title: Lucia — Fine Art Print (2025)
caption: From 'The Existentialist' series — Manuel Cech.
description_html: Lucia portrays the fragile balance between light and decay — a meditation on human endurance and identity. The work captures a quiet transformation through stillness.

title: Mirror — Digital Self-Portrait (2025)
caption: Museum-grade fine art print · 40 × 40 cm · 2025
description_html:
Mirror is a museum-grade fine art print of a digital self-portrait reflecting the quiet tension between identity and perception. The surface remains calm while pressure gathers beneath it; the piece asks for time rather than quick answers.

Format: strict square, 40 × 40 cm. The palette is restrained, contrasts are deliberate, edges stay precise.
dedication_html: For those who allow the surface to look back.
category_notes_html: Notes: physical museum-grade fine art print (no digital download). Ships after production in protective packaging. Delivery times depend on destination. Maintain the square aspect ratio when framing.
